Case 1:26-cv-02331-RDA-IDD              Document 70     Filed 09/17/26       Page 1 of 1 PageID# 731




                                UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT
                                EASTERN DISTRICT OF VIRGINIA
                                       Alexandria Division

  MARVELLE J. BALLENTINE,

                          Plaintiff,

         V.                                               Civil Action No. 1 :26-cv-2331 (RDA/IDD)

  KATIE HALL, ef c}/. ,

                          Defendants.



                                               NOTICE

         This matter is before the Court onpro se PlaintiffMarvelle J. Ballentine's Motion for Leave

  to File Sur-Reply. Dkt. 43. The Court has dispensed with oral argument because it would not aid

  in the decisional process. Fed. R. Civ. P. 78(b); Local Civil Rule 7//J.       Upon consideration of

  Plaintiff s Motion (Dkt. 43) and Memorandum in Support (Dkt. 44), and for good cause shown, it

  is hereby

         ORDERED that Plaintiff s Motion for Leave to File Sun-Reply is GRANTED; and it is

         FURTHER ORDERED that Plaintiffs Proposed Sur-Reply, attached to the Motion as

  Exhibit A, is DEEMED FILED as of the date of this Order.

         It is SO ORDERED.

         The Clerk's Office is directed to provide a copy to pro se Plaintiff at his last known address.
